## Description

A tiny pennate diatom (3–7 × 2–4 µm) that dominates polar sea ice: it grows in the brine channels
below zero degrees (cultured at −2 to 2 °C).

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `sea_ice` (weight 4); 20 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A 7 × 5 µm silhouette (a smaller one is not stable as a soft body) with its thickness reduced to keep
the real volume (~30 µm³). It lives in the `sea_ice` biome.
